Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this match. We look forward to your company on Sunday for all the action from the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier. Do join us. Cheers!

UAE skipper, Ahmed Raza, says that it is a great feeling and a real morale booster for his team. Feels that Stirling batted really well and they knew he likes to take the innings deep. On being asked about Mustafa's approach at the start, Raza replies that he knows Rohan for more than 10 years now and he is one of the most experienced members of the squad. Mentions that Rohan knows his role and he does not need to be reminded about that. Raza is delighted to be on the winning side as a captain.

Ireland skipper, Gary Wilson, feels that Rohan Mustafa killed the game at the start with his stroke making. Says that the UAE bowled really well and they adapted to the conditions better than them. Credits Ahmed Raza and especially Rohan Mustafa as he took a 4-fer and also scored quickfire runs. He is looking forward to the next game and is confident that they will bounce back.

Man of the Match, Rohan Mustafa, feels that he bowled really well. Shares that he had practiced death bowling and that proved to be very fruitful for him. Further adds that they wanted to bowl slow as they saw in their previous match how it affected them. Tells that they knew that it was not easy to clear the boundaries as the ground is very big. On his death bowling, Mustafa replies that he is used to bowling in the death overs even in the Canadian T20 League. He states that they decided to attack the spinners from the word go and believes that luck was also on his side today.

Ireland will be disappointed with their overall performance. Their batsmen didn't apply themselves on a demanding surface and it was only Paul Stirling who showed the stomach for a fight. But a flurry of wickets in the backend of their batting innings hurt them badly and they suffered a humiliating loss. The move to start with spinners backfired on the Irish team and post that, skipper Gary Wilson didn't show enough faith in his tweakers. The speedsters bowled their hearts out but there wasn't much help for them. It's a reality check for them and they have to revisit their strategies before the next match.

A chase well-planned in the end by the home team! They knew that the pitch will slow down and stroke making won't be easy and hence pressed on the accelerator inside the Powerplay. Rohan Mustafa took the charge and then the pair of Darius D'Silva and Muhammad Usman continued with the momentum. The early onslaught meant that there was no scoreboard pressure on UAE and in spite of some good bowling by Ireland, the hosts sailed home with 3 overs to spare.

Thumping victory for UAE! They got outplayed last evening and have bounced back to thrash one of the pre-tournament favourites in Ireland. It was the Rohan Mustafa all-round show that hurt the Irish team! He first claimed a 4-wicket haul and then provided the early impetus to the run chase. His innings caught Ireland off guard and they never really recovered.
FOUR! UAE win by 5 wickets and with three overs left! A full toss on the pads, Ahmed picks it up and lifts it over the infield for a boundary at mid-wicket. Smiles return in the home team's camp.
Width on offer outside off, Boota gets it away off the bottom edge towards gully for one.
Soft outside edge! Slower in pace and it's on a length outside off. Boota pushes inside the line and gets an outside edge. It goes on one bounce to the keeper.
A low full toss on off, Boota tries flicking but it takes the leading half of his bat and rolls to the left of mid off.
Slower one, on a length and wide outside off, Ahmed winds up for a big shot but after realizing the slowness of the delivery, he just plays it down to point for one.
Good length delivery outside off, Boota guides it down to third man for a run.
Mark Adair is back on to bowl what could be the last over of this chase.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Good length delivery just outside off, Ahmed looks to guide it fine towards third man but misses.
SIX! Full length ball and Waheed sends this delivery packing over mid-wicket as he plays a slog for a maximum.
Mohammad Boota is the new batsman.

OUT! RUN OUT! Disaster strikes twice for UAE! Shoddy running to say the least. Fullish ball just outside off, Waheed Ahmed plays this one towards the off side and sets off for a run. However, he then denies his partner and D'Silva is sold down the river. The fielder there, Dockrell, picks it up and throws it to the bowler who dislodges the bails in no time. Wicket number 5 down for UAE and they would want to improve on their running between the wickets in the next game.
On the pads of Darius, he flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, pushed toward mid on.
Bowling change. Shane Getkate returns into the attack to bowl the 16th over.
FOUR! On the pads of Ahmed, he flicks it nonchalantly towards backward square leg for a boundary. UAE just 11 runs short of the victory.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards point.

Loud appeal by the Irish players but looks out of desperation rather than anything else. Fullish ball outside off, Ahmed looks to drive this one but misses ity. The ball goes to Wilson and the Irish players appeal but nothing from the umpire.
On the pads, Darius flicks this one towards square leg and takes a single.
Waheed Ahmed is the new batsman.

OUT! Big mix-up and UAE have lost another wicket! Is there any twist in the tale? 16 needed more off 34 balls. A good length ball around off, D'Silva plays it down towards point where Tector dives full length to his right to stop the racing ball. Seeing Darius initially interested in a run, Shahzad puts his skates on and scoots to the other end. Tector quickly recovers from his dive, gets up to pick the ball and throws it to the bowler. Both batsmen are at the striker's end and Delany easily takes the bails off at his end. Suicidal.
Length ball outside off, Shahzad helps it towards third man for one.
Length ball outside off, Shahzad guides this one towards third man for a single.
Shahzad almost chops it on. Length ball just outside off, Shahzad looks to guide it towards third man but bottom edges it almost onto the off pole. Close call! It bounces over the stumps.
Length ball around off, Shahzad defends this one off the back foot.
Slight halt in play. Shahzad spots that the piece of a stud has been broken and he picks it up and gives it to the umpire.
Length ball outside off, D'Silva pushes this one towards point for a single.
Darius shuffles across and flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball close to the body, pushed towards point.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Rameez throws his bat but fails to make any connection. Although there seems to be some noise. No one is appealing, so no use.
Pitches it up and outside off, D'Silva drives it with good timing to sweeper cover for a single. 21 more needed.
Full and on middle, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! What a shot! Delany digs in a short delivery, Darius hangs on the back foot, fetches it from outside off and nails his pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence. His first boundary after facing 32 balls.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Shahzad eases it off his pads through backward square leg for one. 100 comes up for UAE!
Wide! Loose delivery. Puts a slip in place and bowls a shortish length ball down the leg side. Rameez shoulders arms.
A slip comes in for the new batsman.
Starts with a good length ball on middle and leg, D'Silva works it through square leg for a run.
Rameez Shahzad is the new batsman. 29 needed off 48 balls. Change of ends for David Delany as well.

OUT! CAUGHT! Usman departs after a good cameo! Jaffa by Rankin to dismiss him but he has done his work here. Good length ball on the off pole line, Usman looks to defend this one off the back foot. The ball though nips away a fraction and takes the outside edge of Usman's blade. It carries to skipper Wilson behind the stumps who takes it easily. Just a hiccup in the run chase for UAE.

Good fielding by Tector! D'Silva plays this length ball towards backward point. Tector dives to his right and parries the ball towards cover. The batters take one as the cover fielder picks the ball, turns and has a shy at the non-striker's end.
Length ball on off, Darius D'Silva defends this one off the back foot.
Usman plays this one towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length ball outside off, Muhammad rocks back and pulls this one away towards mid-wicket for a sensational boundary.

Run out chance missed by Ireland! Usman plays this one towards extra cover and steps out looking for a run. The non-striker responds but then Usman sends him back. The fielder from extra cover attacks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Boyd Rankin is back into the attack. 2-0-16-0 from him so far.
Length ball again, D'Silva cuts this one straight to point. UAE need 35 off 54 balls.
Length ball outside off, slower in pace, Usman waits and guides this one fine towards third man for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Usman looks to flick it down the leg side but misses.
Usman pushes this one off the front foot towards mid on.
FOUR! UAE on a roll! Length ball outside off, Muhammad Usman goes back and cuts this through point for a boundary. Ireland continue to leak runs.
On the pads of Usman, he flicks this one toward deep square leg. The batters take a couple.
Darius D'Silva flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mark Adair returns into the attack. 2-0-5-1, he was exceptional in his first spell.
Usman punches this length ball off the back foot towards the off side. 11 from the over and UAE are in cruise control of this chase.
FOUR! Now a comeback by Usman! Good length ball outside off, Muhammad Usman crunches it through extra cover for a smashing boundary. Best shot of the evening!
Good comeback by David! Length ball just outside the off pole, Usman cannot do anything with it and guides it towards backward point.
FOUR! Good batting by Usman! Short of a length ball outside off, Usman rocks back and pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length ball outside off, Usman strokes it towards the deep point region for a couple.
Wide! Third wide in two overs by David. Not what Ireland want. Down the leg side, Usman looks to pull it fine towards the leg side but misses. Wided.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, Usman pushes this one towards mid on.
Good fielding by Getkate! D'Silva pushes this one back towards mid on. Getkate at mid-wicket runs across and dives to his left to save a run. Good effort!
UAE keeping the scoreboard ticking. Usman pushes this floated one towards cover for a single.
D'Silva flicks this one towards square leg for a single.
On the pads of Usman, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Floated outside off, too much width on offer. Usman lifts this one over the cover fielder and the ball races to the fence.
Good start by Gareth. Floats this one up in the air, the ball pitches and straightens beating the outside edge of Usman's blade.
Gareth Delany, the cousin of David, is into the attack now. He is a leggie.
Darius defends this good length ball back towards the bowler. End of a successful over for Ireland.
Fuller this time on middle and off, Usman pushes this one towards cover and takes a single to get off the mark.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, again Usman looks to flick but misses.
Muhammad Usman punches this one off the back foot towards backward point.
Wide! Down the leg side, Usman looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Usman defends his first ball off the back foot towards the bowler.
Muhammad Usman is the next man in for UAE.

OUT! TIMBER! The man in form for UAE is out of here! Back of a length ball on the leg pole line, Mustafa rocks back and makes room to cut this one through the off side. However, he misses his attempted shot as he is beaten for pace and Delany hits the stumps. David is pumped up as he knows the key man is out of here. UAE need 65 off 76 balls but Ireland are in with a shout now.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, D'Silva pushes this one towards mid on for a single.
David Delany is into the attack now.
Another single! Full and on off, this is stroked towards mid off for one.

Excellent running! A short one on the body, Rohan pulls it down towards deep backward square leg. The batters take two and then Darius wanted the third. Mustafa hesitates but goes for it. In the end they complete it with ease.
A slower short ball on off, D'Silva pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Good length again on off, Darius digs it out to covers.
One more single as this is pushed towards cover again.
Good length and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shane Getkate is into the attack now.
Length delivery outside off, Mustafa looks to cut but misses it. Powerplay dominated by UAE! They have got a perfect start.
Darius looks to defend but it comes off the inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and takes a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman through point. A spirited effort by the fielder to ensure the ball doesn't cross the line. They manage to come back for the second.
Short ball wide outside off, Mustafa first looks to help it but then tries to play the upper cut. He misses the ball completely as it is too wide. Wided by the umpire after a long thought.
Good single this one. Darius drops this one towards the point region and takes a single.
Length ball on off, D'Silva defends this one back towards the bowler.
Mustafa moves across to the leg side and looks to hit it through the off side. Rankin however follows him and bowls it on his body. Rohan works it towards fine leg and takes a single.
A dot to end! Adair gets away with one there. Another top over by him. This is short and outside off. D'Silva looks to cut but misses.
One more slower one outside off, Darius looks to defend but is beaten.
Rohan comes down the track but Adair bowls it on the body. He drops it towards the off side and takes one.
A single now! Shorter and around off, the batter makes room and hits it towards point for one.
Another slower one. The batter plays it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back.
A slower ball outside off, D'Silva goes after it but misses.

FOUR! He being off strike has surely not done any harm to his momentum. He has smoked this delivery. Mustafa makes room and Rankin bowls it full and on the stumps. RM crashes it through covers for a boundary. 9 from this over!
Rohan Mustafa is finally on strike. He last faced a ball in the second over and since has been deprived of strike. Has that hampered his momentum?
Almost drags it on! This is shorter and outside off, D'Silva looks to push at it away from the body but ends up getting an inside edge which goes closely past the stumps and on the leg side for one.
A lovely shot that. This is slightly short and on off, the batter stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and hits it through point for a couple.
One more ball on a length around off, D'Silva goes back and keeps it out.
Fuller and on the pads, this is flicked to the man at mid-wicket.
Gets it right this time. On off, this is kept out nicely.
Rankin has not got it right here. Another wide by him. Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses. Wided again.
A false start by him. Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses. Wided.

Skipper Gary Wilson is a quick learner. He is not going to bowl any more spin inside the Powerplay. Brings his speedster Boyd Rankin now. He needs to do something similar to what Adair did in the last over.
A single to end a successful over. This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
One more good length ball on off, the batter keeps it out.
Edgy runs! Two. One more slower ball on off, the batter looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge down towards third man.
On middle, the batter works it to mid-wicket.
Darius D'Silva walks out to bat.

OUT! Kaboom! Why didn't they start with this guy? He comes on and straightaway takes a wicket. A much-needed one for Ireland. Yes, it is not the man who is smashing them around the park but a wicket is a wicket. That is an excellent slower one. Full and on middle. Ahmed is way too early in his heave. He misses and the ball hits the stumps behind. Ireland need a few more quickly.
Good length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Mark Adair to bowl now.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Mustafa now takes the aerial route and goes over the covers. Mustafa has come out all guns blazing and wants to end the run chase quickly it seems. 32 in two overs!
FOUR! Another reverse sweep and similar result. Again Mustafa goes down on one knee to this ball and reverse sweeps it powerfully through backward point for a boundary. Rohan is on fire!
FOUR! Reverse swept in style! Floated outside off, Mustafa gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps this one through the point region for a boundary.
Full and floated on middle, pushed towards mid on for one.
Dropped? Short and wide outside off, Mustafa goes back and cuts it towards the man at point. Gareth Delany there dives forward and tries to catch it but the ball falls just short.
Flatter delivery on the pads, he flicks this one towards square leg for one.
Paul Stirling to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Make that three in a row! 17 from the first over. UAE have got off to an excellent start. Top notch batting. Mustafa is toying with the field here. They brought the square leg up. He brings out the slog sweep and hits it over the man there and bags another boundary.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over. Mustafa is on a roll in this game. Did it with the ball and now doing it with the bat. He steps down the track again and lofts it with ease over the bowler for one more boundary.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over and this is better than the last one. Mustafa comes down the track again, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Slightly shorter this time, the batter works it to the man at square leg.
FOUR! Up and over! That is some shot and some way to get off the mark! First ball but Mustafa needs no sighters. He makes room, gets a full ball and hits it over mid on for a boundary.
UAE are off the mark! This is fired on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.

We are back for the chase. The Irish players are back out on the field after a sub-par batting performance. They are joined by the UAE openers, Rohan Mustafa and Ashfaq Ahmed. George Dockrell to start the proceedings for Ireland with the ball.
